box.text: Oh! Are you also visitors here for the Rite of Descension?
To think I've lived all these years and never come to see this before.
I guess it's like they say. Locals never visit the tourist spots.
I wish you well on your travels! Liyue always welcomes you!
box.text:paimon: Thanks! So we wanna know where to go if we wanna see the Rite of Descension?
box.text: Hmm... You're not at all close. Not to mention that if I Gave you directions, as outlanders, you'd get lost along the way.
So better to head to Yujing Terrace, to the high ground.
It's the highest place in the harbor - sounds like the best place for trying to communicate with deities, no?
